text:
Aria: started a 6% canary for v8-quant3-longdoc at 09:10. Early A/B shows rerank MRR delta concentrated on session-affinity prefixes: ~-9.6% on long prompts. p95 latency +18ms. No halluc lift. Noticing entropy of softmax logits is lower on canary traces. Anyone else? :thinking_face:

Ben: summary from the short window:
```
slice=longdoc_sessions_by_prefix
baseline=v7.2-fp16 rerank_mrr=0.448
canary=v8-quant3 rerank_mrr=0.405
delta=-0.043 (-9.6%)
latency.p95: 166ms -> 184ms
logit_entropy: baseline=3.12, canary=2.74
kv_affinity_miss_rate: 0.5% -> 1.7%
```
Patterns tied to low affinity (prefix hashing bouncing between hosts) + reduced entropy possibly from quant smoothing.

Sven: our rollout gates currently use mrr_drop 8% and halluc_abs 2%. For affinity-sensitive slices we should add an "entropy_guard" and an affinity-stability gate. Proposal: auto-fallback if any of: rerank_mrr_pct_drop >5% OR latency_p95_increase >15ms OR logit_entropy_drop_pct >10% OR kv_affinity_miss_rate >1%. That would've aborted this.

Aria: agree. also we should enable a short "grace ramp" that prevents >1% jumps for affinity-tagged routes until affinity_stability window passes. Patch snippet I'll apply to rollout yaml:
```yaml
canary_percent: 6
affinity_tags: [session_prefix]
grace_ramp:
  max_step_pct: 1
  stability_window_sec: 1800
auto_fallback:
  - metric: rerank_mrr_pct_drop
    threshold_pct: 5.0
    window_secs: 600
  - metric: latency_p95_ms_abs
    threshold_abs: 15
    window_secs: 600
  - metric: logit_entropy_pct_drop
    threshold_pct: 10.0
    window_secs: 600
  - metric: kv_affinity_miss_rate_pct
    threshold_pct: 1.0
    window_secs: 600
```
Applying and scaling canary to 1% while we investigate.

Ben: short-term mitigation: I'll pin session-affinity hashing for the canary pool so prefixes map to the same host set (no bouncing). This doesn't change the model, just routing. Opening CL. :wrench:

Sven: also suggest adding a "deadman entropy" watch: if logit_entropy drops >12% for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets trigger immediate rollback. It's cheap and catches smoothing effects from quant kernels.

Aria: good call. adding logit_entropy probe to the canary dashboard and a synthetic affinity-warmup job (300 prefixes) to run before any >1% ramp.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2200 opened: "v8-quant3 longdoc prefix-affinity rerank regression (canary)". Watchers: eng-ml, eng-platform.

Aria: Plan: 1) apply new auto-fallback thresholds + grace ramp (done), 2) reduce live canary to 1%, 3) deploy routing pin for affinity (Ben), 4) run synthetic affinity warmup + collect logit_entropy and kernel traces, 5) decide rollback vs kernel retune. Tagging @dev-sre for warmup runner. :thumbsup:
